description: Aalto University and collaborators publish ACUMEN train-passenger estimation software that applies data fusion and a Kalman filter to estimate passengers and fill dataset gaps. The native description links the Passengers_estimation_Helsinki GitHub repository and identifies the archived commit. Zenodo supplies a ZIP of the code freely under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the Helsinki-labelled train-passenger application, but exact stations, observation dates, sampling interval, state variables and source data are unknown from the inspected metadata. It supports transport-network modelling through passenger estimation, not a newly accessible passenger dataset. The related tram-passenger workflow uses different machine-learning models and ground-truth comparisons. A limitation is that the short description supplies no error metrics or validation results. No code, passenger records or repository README was read, and execution requirements and estimation accuracy remain unverified.
